findings.title: Shared matrix rows left missing with no owning FEAT (DES-AC-13, CR3-AC-59, CR3-AC-67, CR3-BA-15)
findings.detail: The matrix check for FEAT-007 lists four rows whose phase column names only completed FEATs (FEAT-005/006/007) but whose status is still missing. DES-AC-13 leaves /model ('remain (FEAT-007/009)'); CR3-AC-59 leaves stopped_message_generation ending the stream within 2 s (build-plan item 49, FEAT-010); CR3-AC-67 leaves the next turn after /resume and the U12 409 for a crashed streaming row; CR3-BA-15 records both parts done but stays missing. None of these ids is in a FEAT-009/010 item's Rows list, so only the final gate's $f='.' check would surface them, after FEAT-009/010 closed without testing those criteria (the FEAT-005 close-out rule: no row whose phase names only a closed FEAT). Fix: set each row done where nothing remains (CR3-BA-15 looks complete); otherwise add the owning FEAT to the phase column and the row id to that item's Rows (item 49 for the Stop/U12 parts, the FEAT-009 /model item for DES-AC-13).

findings.title: Scout/reviewer GitHub MCP path never exercised live
findings.detail: In the sandbox-llm container the wrapper reads the token from $HOME/.ossbot/github-read-token and the server needs HTTPS_PROXY; the agents' mcpServers.github sets no env, so both depend on kiro-cli forwarding its environment to MCP children, which nothing has shown (the Hermes path sets them explicitly and passed live). A miss fails closed into a scout without GitHub tools, while GHMCP-2 reads done on hermetic evidence. Fix: add literal env values (HOME=/home/agent, the 3128 proxy URL; no ${VAR} expansion needed) to mcpServers.github in ossbot-scout/ossbot-reviewer, and run one research-profile scout or reviewer job in the Phase 2 gate.
